title: Research: H2-sem admission of the PR848 copy-path helper-sharing wrap (no new kappa)
body:
**Prepared by Aaron Wang, with help from opencode.** Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed. No new kappa, no selected-frontier or supplier change.

## Scope

Card `bit-helper-contract` (scope key `bfb61f829a81535adeae`, chooser OS nonce `df6f572bc7d7dbccbe487fe013268a12`, priority revision 3), scope **refined** to one replacement H2/K implication, per the card's first experiment ("write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-mixing operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs"). Base main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. Claim: [discussion 1166 comment 18920693](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18920693).

Object: the helper-writing copy-path sharing wraps that [PR848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/848) (`research/r439-copy-path-sharing-barrier`) recorded as rejected by the inherited gate-local H2 (`H2_D_frame0_targets_from_helpers`), against the exact replacement contract H2-sem of [PR1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194) (`research/r439-semantic-d-contract-seed10/PROOF.md`). PR848 priced the D-portion sharing as an arithmetic upper bound only (best pair 277 -> 434, saving 65; seed-42 greedy disjoint matching 205 pairs / 6,231 source reads) and left it interface-blocked.

**Audited implication (I).** If a wrapped D section satisfies H2-sem conditions 1-3 with the semantic matrix N unchanged, and the unchanged `xcheck_p.py` owner checker passes every inherited H1-H5/U/J/K-C flag on the [PR 1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194) virtual splice, then the [PR 1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194) chronological substitution bridge transfers the interleaved-lemma conclusion to the wrapped word on arbitrary dirty inputs.

## Evidence (package `research/r439-copyshare-h2sem-admission/`, no new kappa)

| wrap | H2-sem 1-3 | boundary operator (661 columns) | frames at D/A cut | semantic K | inherited flags failing | D source reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---:|
| single pair 277 -> 434 | pass | exact | equal | N = K | exactly H2, K_equals_D | 18,020 (-65) |
| seed-42 greedy matching (205 pairs) | pass | exact | equal | N = K | exactly H2, K_equals_D | 11,854 (-6,231) |
| PR848 C2 target-temp control | pass | exact | equal | N = K | none | 18,087 (+2) |

So the PR848 obstruction is scoped to the inherited gate-local H2 only: under H2-sem the helper-sharing wraps are admissible, and the semantic K check passes exactly where the literal extractor fails. All 661 basis columns are replayed exactly; by [PR 1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194)'s F2-module argument coefficient equality on those columns is equality on every module, covering arbitrary dirty streams in the stated interpretation.

Falsification attempts (why each clause matters):

- F1 unrestored helper temp: rejected at endpoints. F2 wrong restore operand: boundary equation broken on a dirty helper column. F3 restore at a mid-body chronological cut: boundary equation broken.
- **F4 target-feeding-helper wrap** (span closed before the fed target's own single D gate): scalar operator exact, endpoint passes, frames equal; rejected **only** by H2-sem condition 2 (the retained no-target-feedback clause; the checker's H1 also fails). Any weaker replacement that drops that clause would admit it.
- **F5 source-feeding-helper wrap**: scalar operator exact, but the framed replay rejects the frame-0 source read outright (`climb not nested: register 0 from frame 2 (dim 1) to frame 0 (dim 0)`). Raw operator identity does not justify frame-sensitive execution, confirming at one instance [PR 1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194)'s and `r439-abc-semantic-bridge`'s warning.

PR848's complete oriented-pair census (430 operands, 184,470 pairs, 41,404 positive) and seed-42 greedy matching are recomputed deterministically and checked against the recorded constants.

## Reproduce

From the repository root (standard library only):

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-copyshare-h2sem-admission
```

Expected `PASS_R439_COPYSHARE_H2SEM_ADMISSION pair=277->434 saving=65 matching_pairs=205 matching_saving=6231 columns=661 controls=7 no_new_kappa` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r439-copyshare-h2sem-admission outcome=completed` (observed on Windows/CPython 3.12; `--check-only` gives `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`). `test_package.py` replays at a fresh path and rejects a mutated source pin, a mutated certificate and a missing pin block. `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'` passes (42 tests, 2 skipped).

## Remaining obligations (explicitly not claimed)

- No priced construction: the 6,231 figure remains a source-read arithmetic bound. F/B envelopes, the 104/192-bit expressions, COPY/ERASE accounting and the paid profile were not recomputed; intermediate integer envelopes can differ at an identical binary endpoint, so the precision guards remain open. No word is proposed as a supplier.
- No kappa, frontier, native/hosted admission; all-size compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, recovery and analytic obligations untouched.
- The bridge is [PR1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194)'s, applied. Whether H2-sem condition 2 is necessary at a framed level is open (F4 is the recorded boundary probe); greedy-matching optimality is not claimed.

## Overlap and credit

Submission-time `find_overlap.py` (446 open PRs incl. drafts, 418 discussion records, complete pagination, 2026-10-14 09:50 UTC) matches only this package, its claim and [PR848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/848)'s own record; not a novelty certificate. Credit: **Aaron Wang, [PR848](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/848)** (pair census, greedy matching, C1-C3 controls reused here), **woklerx, [PR1194](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1194)** (H2-sem contract and chronological substitution bridge), **Arham Tahir** (`research/r439-abc-semantic-bridge`, the bridge-application pattern), **eumemic [PR555](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/555)** and **DreamingOfClouds [PR589](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/589)** (the R439 word), and the retained scalar-interface/xcheck lineage. Word and checker are consumed as pinned sources; no predecessor package is vendored or modified. Overlap with concurrent register-model work (discussion 1317) is disjoint in object.
